sources.note_zh: 2024年GDP 12907.1亿元增长6.0%；常住人口312.2万；三产占92.49%；居民人均可支配收入105701元；全国重点实验室92家；国高新近万家；独角兽51家；每万人口高价值发明专利539.95件；技术合同成交3806.9亿元；0-14岁11.8%/60岁+23.0%。

sources.title_zh: 海淀区AI产业与创新生态数据（官方发布+公开媒体，2024-2026）
sources.title_en: Haidian AI Industry and Innovation Ecosystem Data (Official + Media, 2024-2026)
sources.authority: 中关村科学城管委会/海淀区政府/北京市政府新闻办 + 新京报/澎湃/36氪/投中网公开报道
sources.note_zh: 本来源整合海淀区AI产业官方发布数据与公开媒体报道：①官方发布（2025年9月北京市政府新闻发布会）：AI核心产业规模2822亿元(2024)占北京近80%增速30%；AI企业1900+；大模型备案104款；万P智算集群；人才200.45万；院士646位占全国35.8%；研发投入占GDP 12%+；1+X+1产业体系；信软业2万亿。②公开媒体报道（2025-2026）：独角兽企业约26-51家（不同统计口径，占北京73%/全国26%）；AI学者1.23万；大模型六小虎4家在中关村2km半径；王慧文黄金框；两区一带多点官方规划。本方案正文统一采用官方发布口径（2822亿/104款/1900+企业），媒体数据仅作背景参考。不同统计口径的差异已在正文中说明。
sources.note_en: This source integrates official Haidian AI industry data and public media reports: ①Official release (Sep 2025 Beijing municipal government press conference): AI core industry scale 282.2 billion CNY (2024), accounting for nearly 80% of Beijing with 30% growth; 1900+ AI enterprises; 104 filed large models; 10,000P computing cluster; 2.0045 million talents; 646 academicians accounting for 35.8% nationwide; R&D investment 12%+ of GDP; 1+X+1 industrial system; 2 trillion CNY software industry. ②Public media reports (2025-2026): approximately 26-51 unicorn enterprises (different statistical calibers, accounting for 73% of Beijing/26% nationwide); 12,300 AI scholars; 4 of the "six tiger" large model companies within 2km radius of Zhongguancun; Wang Huiwen golden frame; official "two zones, one belt, multiple points" planning. This proposal uniformly adopts official release caliber (282.2 billion/104 models/1900+ enterprises), media data only as background reference. Differences in statistical calibers are explained in the text.
sources.data_confidence: medium (official data for 2024; media estimates for 2025-2026 projections)

sources.note_zh: rendering-key-001/002/003.jpg为使用Stable Diffusion XL（开源AI图像生成模型，依据CreativeML Open RAIL-M协议）生成的建筑效果意向图，用于表达建成后的空间氛围、材质和尺度感，非真实建筑设计方案。图中建筑形态、街道网格和具体位置与真实地图不对应，空间位置以总平面图和空间分析轴测图为准。AI生成图不构成建筑设计成果或施工依据，商业使用前需另行清权。
sources.note_en: rendering-key-001/002/003.jpg are AI-generated architectural rendering concepts using Stable Diffusion XL (open source AI image generation model under CreativeML Open RAIL-M license), for illustrating post-construction spatial atmosphere, materials and scale sense, not actual architectural design solutions. Building forms, street grids and specific locations in the images do not correspond to real maps; spatial positions refer to master plan and spatial analysis axonometric drawings. AI-generated images do not constitute architectural design deliverables or construction basis; additional rights clearance required before commercial use.
sources.attribution_text: AI-generated conceptual renderings using Stable Diffusion XL; not architectural design solutions
sources.use_restrictions: Conceptual atmosphere illustration only; not for construction, marketing, or commercial use without additional rights clearance

sources.note_zh: 本方案品牌系统（智脉京张名称、Logo、色彩体系、字体规范）为瓮永生/FTA Group为本次竞赛原创的概念设计成果，Logo设计灵感来源于人字形铁路道岔与神经突触隐喻，非衍生自任何现有商标或受版权保护的标识。商标注册和商业使用授权尚未完成，落地需另行清权（商标检索、注册策略、商业使用授权）。中文字体使用微软雅黑（Windows系统字体），英文使用Helvetica Neue/Arial（系统字体）及Noto Sans（开源字体，SIL OFL 1.1协议），等宽字体使用Consolas（系统字体）及Source Code Pro（开源字体，SIL OFL 1.1协议）。品牌应用场景（导视、公共艺术、数字界面、办公文创、环境传播）均为概念设计，待专业团队深化和授权后实施。
sources.note_en: The brand system (Zhimai Jing-Zhang name, logo, color system, font specifications) is an original conceptual design by Weng Yongsheng / FTA Group for this competition. The logo design is inspired by the herringbone railway switch and neural synapse metaphor, and is not derived from any existing trademark or copyrighted logo. Trademark registration and commercial use authorization are not yet completed; additional clearance required for implementation (trademark search, registration strategy, commercial use authorization). Chinese fonts use Microsoft YaHei (Windows system font), English uses Helvetica Neue/Arial (system fonts) and Noto Sans (open source, SIL OFL 1.1), monospace uses Consolas (system font) and Source Code Pro (open source, SIL OFL 1.1). Brand application scenarios (wayfinding, public art, digital interfaces, office merchandise, environmental communication) are conceptual designs, pending professional team development and authorization.

sources.logo_originality_statement: The Zhimai Jing-Zhang logo is an original conceptual design created for this competition, inspired by the herringbone railway switch and neural synapse metaphor. It is not derived from any existing trademark or copyrighted logo. Commercial use requires trademark registration and additional clearance.

sources.note_en: All analysis figures in this proposal except satellite basemap and AI renderings (land use structure, mobility blue-green, phasing implementation, indicator system, 1909 protocol mechanism, AI-native spatial typology, regional synergy, three-core detailed design, concept section, urban design guidelines, implementation roadmap, AI verification protocol, etc.) are original analysis figures programmatically generated by Weng Yongsheng / FTA Group using Python matplotlib/reportlab based on public data (OSM roads, task package geometry, proposal conceptual data), with no third-party copyright restrictions. sources.note_en: This proposal is an original conceptual design submission by Weng Yongsheng / FTA Group for the 'Jing-Zhang AI Innovation Belt' urban design competition. Overall copyright belongs to the submitter, with authorized use for competition review and display. Third-party materials included in the proposal (OSM data, open source fonts, AI generation models) are used under their respective license agreements, as declared item by item in sources.json. Satellite imagery basemap is a conceptual composite based on public data, AI renderings are conceptual intentions generated using open source models, and the logo is an original conceptual design; commercial use authorization for these three types of materials is not yet completed, and additional clearance is required before formal implementation and commercial use. All analysis figures, text, data and spatial design other than the above three types of materials are original to the submitter, with no third-party copyright restrictions.
